<section class="paragraph-id-73036 paragraph--type--basic container--spacer container gutter paragraph container--block-basic">
  <a id="paragraph-73036"></a>
  <header class="hgroup hgroup--center hgroup--limited">
      <h2 class="heading-h">At one with water</h2>
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><p>With an exquisite&nbsp;crystal clear&nbsp;lagoon offering moderate waves and strong consistent winds,&nbsp;Amanpulo&nbsp;is a kite surfer’s paradise. Kite surfers of all levels can launch right from the beach and hone their skills on the lagoon’s vast expanse of shallow turquoise water with&nbsp;a sandy&nbsp;bottom and moderate waves.</p></div>
  </header>
</section>
<section class="paragraph-id-73041 paragraph--type--media-text-side-by-side container--spacer container--text-alignment-default">
      <a id="paragraph-73041"></a>

      </div>
      <header class="card__copy--with-accordion hgroup">
        <div>
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><h3>Harness the wind</h3><p>With clear blue, warm waters, and a bottom of predominantly white sand and occasional sea grass, our lagoon resembles a natural swimming pool, making it easy to walk around and learn how to kite.</p><p>Strategically located to catch the windsport-ideal&nbsp;amihan (northeasterly wind) from December to March, the island also benefits from the venturi caused by larger neighbouring islands.</p><h3>High tech instruction</h3><p>Guests will be linked to their instructor via radio headsets for speed, safety and ease of learning while on the water. Lessons can also include video footage for reviewing the session.</p><h3>Instructors</h3><p>Each kitesurfing lesson is thoughtfully designed to be both thorough and customised to match the individual skill level of every participant—from complete beginners to seasoned riders. Throughout the kitesurfing season, guests benefit from the expert guidance of instructors certified by the International Kite Surfing Organization, who are on hand to ensure safe, progressive learning and an enjoyable experience on the water.&nbsp;</p></div>
        </div>
                  <div class="card__bottom">
                      <div class="card__multiple_links cta-links cta-links--side-by-side">

            </div>
          </div>
      </header>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

          <header class="field--title hgroup hgroup--limited hgroup--center">

    </header>
    </div>
  <div class="bg-white padded-container padded-container--slim"><ul class="list list--columns list--columns--3"><li>World-class instructors</li><li>High quality Naish equipment</li><li>Video links and TV playback for analysis</li><li>Lounging areas</li><li>Artificial turf area for rinsing and drying kites and boards</li><li>Showers and changing rooms</li></ul></div>
